speed._comment: Checked every hour. mustContain = text that must appear in the page HTML (catches blank/broken pages).

pagespeed._comment: Google PageSpeed Insights for the homepage every hour. Add a free API key as the GitHub secret PSI_API_KEY.

products._comment: Every product page is found automatically from the sitemap and speed-checked every hour. include = extra URLs to add, exclude = text; any URL containing it is skipped.

forms._comment: Checked every 4 hours. mode 'submit' = fills in testData and really submits, then waits for the thank-you message / download. mode 'check' = no submission. url 'auto:product' = uses the first product page from the sitemap (or set a fixed product URL). open = how to reveal the form: 'floating' clicks the floating contact button, 'download' clicks the document download button, or put a CSS selector such as '#contact-btn'. pick: 'first' | 'download'.

openText.floating: contact|enquir|inquir|get in touch|talk to|message us|reach us|quote
